name: agentfw
description: Firmware for agent behavior — structured work via Decompose-Parallelize-Verify-Iterate, Planner-Worker-Judge architecture, permission model, structural enforcement gates, persistent state, context degradation resistance, and cross-model tuning (Opus 4.7 without non-target regression). r7.5 publishes the Hermes variant as a pre-release with β-fuse dispatch (validated) and worker quality (r7.6 scope).
author: Brian Taylor
hermes_variant_note: r7.5-hermes-prerelease — β-fuse dispatch layer validated (MoE 17/20 strict first-attempt on r7.4, 11.5×–17× lift over r7.3 baselines); worker-quality ship gate not yet met (r7.5 probe: 3/20 vs 15/20 floor). Not production-ready. See RELEASE-NOTES-r7.5-hermes-prerelease.md and variants/hermes/INSTALL.md.
